notablePrerequisites:
Vedalken Certarch does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Vedalken Certarch.
You control at least three artifacts.
An opponent controls an untapped creature.
description:
Activate Vedalken Certarch by tapping it, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Solitary Sactuary triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Vedalken Certarch.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.
